decision: How should How it works show that step 6 leads back to step 2?
invariants: real photos where we have them, labelled placeholders elsewhere

options.bet: Keep the 3x2 grid; a pencil line draws from 6 back to 2 with a travelling dot
options.benefit: Smallest change; reuses the pencil-line motif

options.bet: Split into 'Once, to start' (Assess) and an 'Every book' panel (2-6) with a stepping highlight and a return arrow
options.benefit: Structure says what repeats; strong on phones
options.risk: Five cards in a row get narrow on desktop

options.bet: Steps 2-6 on a ring with an orbiting dot; Assess enters from outside; centre/side shows the active step
options.cost: Only one step's text visible at a time; most custom code
options.risk: Parents may not read every step
